description: JQL/TQL-style query input: a monospace text field with caret-aware autocomplete (field/operator/value/function/keyword suggestions), inline wavy error underlines with tooltips, keyboard navigation, and a submit event. Pure Blazor except a tiny optional caret helper script; falls back to end-of-text tracking when the script is absent. Its popup is a TmOverlayPanel with ConstrainHeight: the list is capped at the room left on the resolved side (and at its own CSS max-height), and the cap follows the room in both directions — it regrows as room returns while the panel is open. Dismissal (Escape/outside pointerdown via overlay.js, blur, Enter, or accepting a suggestion) stops the debounce timer as well as invalidating in-flight loads, so a pending suggestion fetch can never reopen the dropdown the user just closed.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the query text changes.

parameters.name: SuggestionsProvider
parameters.description: Supplies autocomplete suggestions for the current text and caret position. When null, no dropdown is shown.

parameters.name: Errors
parameters.description: Error ranges to underline in the text (with a tooltip). Also drives aria-invalid.

parameters.name: OnSubmit
parameters.description: Fires when Enter is pressed while the suggestion dropdown is not open.

parameters.name: DebounceMs
parameters.description: Debounce (ms) before querying SuggestionsProvider. Defaults to 200.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text. When null, falls back to the localized default.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Optional label rendered above the input.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables the input and suppresses suggestions.

parameters.name: Monospace
parameters.description: Render with a monospace font (default). Set false for a proportional font.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the root element.

examples.title: TQL query field with autocomplete, error underlines and submit
examples.code:
<TmQueryInput @bind-Value="_query"
              Label="Filter"
              Placeholder="status = Active AND priority IN (High, Critical)"
              SuggestionsProvider="SuggestAsync"
              Errors="_errors"
              OnSubmit="RunQuery" />

@code {
    string? _query;
    IReadOnlyList<QueryErrorSpan> _errors = [];

    Task<IReadOnlyList<QuerySuggestion>> SuggestAsync(QuerySuggestionRequest req)
        => Task.FromResult<IReadOnlyList<QuerySuggestion>>(
            [ new QuerySuggestion("status", "status", QuerySuggestionKind.Field),
              new QuerySuggestion("priority", "priority", QuerySuggestionKind.Field) ]);

    void RunQuery(string q) { /* execute the query */ }
}
